name: cinnamon-app
description: cinnamon — a local-first computer task manager with live processes, graphs and AI diagnostics

scripts.check: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),vm=require("vm");const roots=["main.js","preload.js","lib","ui","test"];let n=0;const walk=(p)=>{const st=fs.statSync(p);if(st.isDirectory()){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(p))walk(path.join(p,e));}else if(path.extname(p)===".js"){new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"),{filename:p});n++;}};roots.forEach(walk);JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8"));const yaml=fs.readFileSync("electron-builder.yml","utf8");if(/\t/.test(yaml))throw new Error("electron-builder.yml contains tabs");for(const k of ["appId: com.cinnamon.app","productName: cinnamon","executableName: cinnamon","cinnamon-${os}-${arch}.${ext}"])if(!yaml.includes(k))throw new Error("electron-builder.yml missing: "+k);console.log("syntax check ok ("+n+" JavaScript files)");'
